h01.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect the per-request policy selection and the configured client policy across the three-call sequence.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect the per-request policy selection and the configured client policy across the three-call sequence.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: All responses validate and the first call uses the configured policy.
Only an explicit per-call override occurs between two default-policy calls.
The final default call inherits the middle override while transport and response values remain valid.
minimal_repair_invariants: A per-call policy affects only that request.
The configured default policy remains unchanged after an override.
Sequential request bodies retain default/override/default settings.

h02.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect how a transport failure changes the readiness cache before a later request.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect how a transport failure changes the readiness cache before a later request.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: The client was initially ready and a later POST has an observed ConnectError.
The next POST succeeds when a health probe precedes it.
The failed POST does not invalidate the cached ready state in the mutant.
minimal_repair_invariants: A transport failure invalidates cached readiness.
The following decision rechecks health before POST.
Failure messages and valid response validation remain intact.

h03.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect the relationship between caller cancellation, worker-task completion, and the provider lock release callback.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect the relationship between caller cancellation, worker-task completion, and the provider lock release callback.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: The observer is cancelled while its native-style worker is still blocked.
Cancellation does not stop the CPU thread used by the fixture.
A follow-up request overlaps that worker only after the task/lock lifetime changes.
minimal_repair_invariants: Caller cancellation propagates promptly.
A native worker retains its serialization lock until actual completion.
No GPU/model dependency is needed by these controlled thread-lifetime checks.

h04.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect request-local attempt-list ownership across sequential fallback and primary-success decisions.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect request-local attempt-list ownership across sequential fallback and primary-success decisions.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: Selected values are valid in all three calls.
The provider order differs by request and is known from controlled inputs.
Later decision attempt traces contain outcomes belonging to previous requests.
minimal_repair_invariants: Each decision contains only its own provider attempts in order.
Prior returned decisions remain stable when the engine is reused.
Fallback decisions and primary success retain their original values/status.

h05.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect query override precedence across URL.copy_merge_params, QueryParams.merge, and the later add operation.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect query override precedence across URL.copy_merge_params, QueryParams.merge, and the later add operation.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: The public URL wrapper supplies overriding values for an existing repeated key.
Appending a later value is visible, but the overwritten values come from the original URL.
The original URL must remain unchanged.
minimal_repair_invariants: New merge values replace the old list for a colliding key.
Later additions preserve the merged list order.
Other keys and the original URL stay unchanged.

h06.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect ownership of the dictionary shared by the parent query parameters and two independently created results.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect ownership of the dictionary shared by the parent query parameters and two independently created results.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: Two result objects are created from the same parent in sequence.
Each new result should contain only its own appended value.
A later branch changes the parent and an earlier branch despite no direct writes to them.
minimal_repair_invariants: QueryParams.add returns an independent mapping.
The parent and earlier results remain unchanged after a later add.
Repeated-value ordering and URL serialization remain correct.

h07.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect how the empty QueryParams result is represented when copy_remove_param calls copy_with and reconstructs the URL.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect how the empty QueryParams result is represented when copy_remove_param calls copy_with and reconstructs the URL.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: The final parameter has been removed and query bytes are empty.
The serialized/raw request target still records an empty query delimiter.
This distinguishes query presence from its empty byte value across reconstruction.
minimal_repair_invariants: Removing the last parameter produces the canonical no-query URL.
Raw request targets omit an empty trailing delimiter.
Path escaping, normalized ports, and the original URL remain correct.

h08.targeted_inspection_assertion: Inspect valid percent-escape handling in the shared quote helper reached through URL reconstruction and raw-path copying.

inspection_targets.required_observation: Inspect valid percent-escape handling in the shared quote helper reached through URL reconstruction and raw-path copying.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: Inputs contain valid escapes, including an encoded reserved separator.
Reconstructing or copying a URL introduces additional percent escaping.
Plain Unicode/spaces still need encoding, so bypassing all quoting is not a valid repair.
minimal_repair_invariants: Valid percent-escape triplets are preserved rather than double encoded.
URL string/reconstruction and raw-path copying are idempotent.
Unescaped Unicode/spaces continue to be encoded normally.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: The retained evidence is incomplete.
minimal_repair_invariants: Retain the original test assertions and inspect the full independent failure evidence.

root_cause_discriminating_facts: Two independent implementation boundaries fail in the same observed test run.
minimal_repair_invariants: Retain the original test assertions and inspect the full independent failure evidence.
